openDisabled: Needs at least one table. Run CREATE TABLE first.
title: Generate data
description: Pick a row count per table, tune columns if needed, then generate. Everything runs in one transaction: cancel midway and the data goes back to how it was.
noTables: There are no tables in the public schema. Run CREATE TABLE first.
columns: Tune {count, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}
maxNote: At most 500,000 rows per table. For a larger scale use the Capacity Advisor (coming later): its numbers come from a formula and carry the Estimated label.
warn500k: 500,000 rows need about 600 MB of RAM for the tab, and a weak machine can take almost a minute. This was measured on one machine (i5-12450H, 15.7 GB RAM), not a prediction for yours.
summary: Data generated: {tables}. Took {seconds} s in this tab, only useful for relative comparison, not a production prediction.
cancelledSummary: Data generation cancelled, the data is back to how it was.
stoppedRolledBack: The session was rebuilt and the half-generated data was rolled back.
